name: pre-read-never-read-session-with-other-bytes-denies-naming-no-writer
description: A session that never read a strict file, offering bytes other than the recorded ones, is denied with the out-of-band text on BOTH backends (#514). B pre-reads CLAUDE.md first, seeding v1 with B's hash and NO last_writer_id (a first observation is not a commit). A then pre-reads the same strict-tracked path for the FIRST time, offering different bytes. No session committed them and none holds an uncommitted write, so the change was made outside the coordinator: the text says so, names a commit through the coordinator as what clears the deny, and promises no Read. This arm used to take the write template and name 'agent <unknown>' for a write nobody committed; the summary still carries '<unknown>' as the last writer, verbatim rather than [:8]-sliced. A has no row to recover, so the deny arms nothing and a second read is denied too (fixture 42). Timestamps vary per run; the reason bytes and the summary shape are the contract.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: CLAUDE.md on disk does not match v1, the last version committed through the coordinator, and no session committed the change, so it was made outside the coordinator. Do not restore or overwrite CLAUDE.md: the change may be your user's work. Tell your user that CLAUDE.md changed outside the coordinator; the read stays denied until the change is committed through the coordinator. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
